svg.title: DNS steering against an edge proxy
svg.desc: Traffic Manager only answers a DNS lookup, with ci-uks's name while its health check passes, and your browser then connects straight to the container. Front Door takes your request at its edge and forwards it over HTTP to ci-uks itself. Both send you to ci-ukw instead when ci-uks fails its checks.
